== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The [[Red]] [[Divine Titan]], also known as Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion's [[Titan]] or the [[Red]] [[Titan]], is a massive [[Aethertech]] machine piloted by [[Raion Raithe|Raion]]. As a [[Divine Titan]], it possesses a level of power comparable to [[Zenith Devices]] and exhibits its own consciousness and personality. While typically stored in [[Subspace]] or at the [[Titan Force headquarters]] within [[Shadow Ark]], it can be summoned to the battlefield to magnify a pilot's [[Combat Art]], making it essential for engaging massive threats like Behemoths. The machine's appearance has evolved significantly; originally a pure scarlet mech with broad chest armor, it later became characterized by glowing orange-gold veins of sunlight that pulse through its metal plates. These veins, influenced by the [[blood]] of a [[solar dragon]], provide immense power but can also corrupt the pilot's mind or cause the machine to act independently. The [[Titan]] is capable of extreme feats, such as manifesting energy wings, transforming an arm into a cannon, and projecting powerful shields or solar-like energy blasts. However, the machine is prone to extreme instability; it has experienced mechanical breakdowns, structural failures due to rushed repairs, and moments of intense emotional volatility where it appears to scream or act with fury. In its most heightened state, the [[Titan]] can perform far beyond the capabilities of other [[Divine Titans]], though this often leaves it on the verge of [[destruction]] or requires the pilot to struggle for control against its overwhelming energy.}}
